Europe's biggest spring water source may be near Portsmouth 💧
Portsmouth Water says the Havant and Bedhampton springs are thought to be the largest individual source of spring water in Europe, providing 30% of the water it supplies. The British Geological Survey puts their combined flow at about 104,000 m³ a day, enough to fill 40 Olympic pools. Spare winter water flows out to sea, so the new Havant Thicket Reservoir will store up to 8.7 billion litres.
